g.text: GATE gate-authz: http://127.0.0.1:8081 (users: alice -> bob, mutation: on)

DELETE /api/orders/{id} as user A object gone for its owner (verified)
AUTHZ-BOLA-READ HIGH User A can read user B's object via 'GET /api/orders/{id}'
AUTHZ-BOLA-WRITE CRITICAL User A can modify user B's object via 'PUT /api/orders/{id}'
AUTHZ-BOLA-DELETE CRITICAL User A can delete user B's object via 'DELETE /api/orders/{id}'
● writes/deletes only on objects created for the test, verified by the owner re-reading them
